slides.h:
5 Word tricks
for when the boss
sends your draft
back covered
in edits.

slides.b: Turn it on before you edit. Every change shows, so nobody asks what you touched.
Review, Display for Review, Simple Markup. The page reads clean, a red line shows where edits are.
Go through edits one at a time with Next. Accept All only once you've read them.
Click Reply in the comment, say what you did, then Resolve. The boss sees it's handled.
Review, Compare. Pick the old and new file and Word marks every difference for you.

Tell Toso what the document is for. Get it finished in Word, clean and ready to send.
Pay with M-Pesa. No card, no monthly bill.
